args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18% following the latest deploy. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status is healthy with error rate normalized to 0.2%. Follow-up needed to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks in production; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back all production regions** to v2.3.0 — this was a rollback to a previously healthy version, so no change-manager approval was required.
3. **Verified recovery**: the service is now healthy in all regions with the error rate normalized to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the need to root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy attempt. The on-call engineer has been paged.
